flowCodeHelp: Business code starts a process by this code. One code can have several versions
suspended: Suspended "{name}". New processes cannot be started while it is suspended
formPathHelp: Frontend page opened during approval (path under views)
deleteHelp: A process that has instances cannot be deleted
confirmBatchDelete: Delete the {count} selected processes? Processes that have instances cannot be deleted
designHelp: Save in the designer, return to the list, then publish the process
designReadonlyHelp: A published process is read-only. Copy it as a new version to change it
noDefinition: No process definition. Open this page from the process definition list
publishHelp: Once published the process can be started, and older versions with the same code expire. Every approval node needs an assignee
unpublishHelp: The process can no longer be started. Running instances are not affected
importHelp: Choose a process definition JSON file exported from this system. It is imported as unpublished
importDrop: Click or drop a JSON file here
importCategoryRequired: Choose the category to import into
